name: Volumetric Light Shafts (URP Raymarching)
definition: A technique for rendering volumetric light shafts (fog beams, atmospheric lighting) in Unity URP using raymarching in a custom shader with main light shadow sampling. It uses a C# controller for dynamic light color, density, and quality settings.
summary: Volumetric Light Shafts (URP Raymarching) renders geometrically consistent crepuscular rays in Unity URP by raymarching through a volume with shadow sampling, unlike cheaper screen-space approximations.
